question:
Convert the following sentence from passive to active voice:

The instructions were misunderstood by several applicants.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the passive voice, the sentence is: "The instructions were misunderstood by several applicants."
 
• To convert to active voice: Place the subject "several applicants" at the beginning.
 
• Change the passive verb form "were misunderstood" to "misunderstood" (past simple active).
 
• Ensure the object "the instructions" remains at the end of the sentence for clarity.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Several applicants misunderstood the instructions."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"Several applicants misunderstand the instructions." – Incorrect tense (present simple instead of past simple).
 
• **Option 3: **"The instructions misunderstood applicants." – Incorrect subject-verb relationship.
 
• **Option 4: **"Applicants misunderstand instructions." – Incorrect tense and missing article "the."
